title: Technical Project Manager – ERP Implementations
description:
**About the Role:**

Silent Infotech is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager to lead end\-to\-end ERP implementation, delivery, transformation, upgrade, migration, integration, and go\-live programs for international customers. The role requires strong ownership of scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, stakeholder communication, and cross\-functional coordination across functional consultants, developers, QA, DevOps, support teams, and customer stakeholders. Hands\-on experience delivering ERP projects is mandatory. Experience with Odoo ERP is an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of ERP implementation projects from discovery and planning through configuration, development, integration, data migration, UAT, go\-live, hypercare, and handover.
* Manage ERP transformation programs involving process redesign, legacy\-system replacement, phased rollouts, upgrades, migrations, and multi\-module implementations.
* Translate customer business requirements into structured project scope, milestones, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate functional consultants, technical teams, developers, QA, DevOps, integration teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure aligned and timely delivery.
* Manage project scope, timelines, resource allocation, budgets/effort, dependencies, change requests, risks, issues, and escalations.
* Lead customer meetings including project kick\-offs, requirement reviews, steering/status meetings, UAT reviews, go\-live readiness, and post\-go\-live support reviews.
* Ensure strong governance through project plans, RAID logs, action trackers, status reports, meeting minutes, documentation, and delivery dashboards.
* Drive fit\-gap analysis and ensure clear decisions between standard ERP functionality, configuration, customization, integration, and process change.
* Manage third\-party integrations, APIs, middleware dependencies, data migration activities, and coordination with external vendors where applicable.
* Plan and govern SIT/UAT cycles, defect resolution, cutover planning, go\-live checklists, rollback/contingency planning, and production readiness.
* Provide live customer interaction and leadership during critical go\-live, hypercare, production support, and escalation situations.
* Identify delivery risks early, establish mitigation plans, remove blockers, and escalate decisions to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Ensure projects meet agreed quality standards, contractual commitments, customer expectations, and internal delivery processes.
* Support presales and solution teams when required with project estimation, implementation approach, delivery timelines, resource planning, and proposal/RFP inputs.
* Mentor project coordinators and team members and contribute to continuous improvement of ERP delivery practices.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Minimum 7\+ years of overall professional experience in IT/ERP project delivery, with demonstrable responsibility for ERP implementation projects.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Strong ERP project/program management experience across proprietary and/or open\-source ERP platforms.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, Odoo, ERPNext, or comparable enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand both functional business processes and technical delivery dependencies including integrations, APIs, data migration, environments, and deployments.
* Strong stakeholder management, customer communication, negotiation, conflict resolution, and escalation\-handling skills.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, dependencies, and teams while maintaining delivery visibility and accountability.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills, including project plans, RAID logs, status reports, effort tracking, action registers, and executive updates.
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Odoo Project, MS Project, or equivalent is a plus
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Business, Management, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to Have:**

* Valid US Business(B1/B2\) visa.
* Prior onsite travel history for customer meetings, discovery, implementation, training, or go\-live activities.
* Experience interacting directly with US, European, Middle East, or other international customers.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, ITIL, or ERP\-vendor certifications.
* Experience in manufacturing, distribution, retail, services, accounting, CRM, supply chain, or other ERP\-intensive business domains.
* Willingness to travel onsite internationally based on project requirements.

**KPIs Not Limited to:**

* On\-time and within\-scope ERP project delivery.
* Budget/effort variance and resource utilization.
* Milestone achievement and schedule adherence.
* Risk, issue, dependency, and change\-request closure effectiveness.
* UAT readiness, defect closure, and go\-live success.
* Customer satisfaction and stakeholder communication quality.
* Post\-go\-live stabilization and reduction of critical escalations.
* Project documentation, governance, and reporting quality.
* Must have independently managed or played a lead delivery role in multiple end\-to\-end ERP implementations, including at least one production go\-live.
* Must have experience working directly with customers and managing cross\-functional functional and technical delivery teams.
* Strong experience in ERP implementation, business process transformation, migration, integration, UAT, go\-live, and post\-go\-live support.
* Experience with international customers and distributed teams is strongly preferred.

Pay: ₹742,762\.43 \- ₹1,498,623\.55 per year

description:
**Project Manager – Wellness Resorts \& Partnerships**

We are looking for a Project Manager to work closely with the senior leadership team, and external partners on wellness resort growth, new venture evaluation, and strategic partnerships.

This role is not limited to tracking tasks. The person will be expected to keep leadership informed, move decisions forward, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and ensure that agreed actions are completed on time.

**Role Purpose**

The Project Manager will act as the central coordination point for a portfolio of wellness resort and partnership initiatives. This includes supporting existing resort operations, assessing potential wellness retreat opportunities in India and overseas, engaging hospitality and technology partners, and maintaining an active network of wellness experts.

The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly with senior executives, business owners, consultants, and potential partners. They should be structured, commercially aware, and able to handle multiple workstreams without losing follow\-through.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary coordination link between the senior leadership team, internal teams, and external stakeholders.
* Prepare regular updates for the leadership team on priorities, decisions required, progress against plans, risks, and next actions.
* Manage project plans, timelines, meeting cadence, action trackers, and stakeholder communications across multiple initiatives.
* Support the growth and improvement of existing wellness resort businesses.
* Evaluate potential wellness retreat, resort, land, property, and business acquisition opportunities in India and, where relevant, international markets.
* Conduct preliminary research on potential locations, including market demand, accessibility, local competition, tourism trends, regulatory considerations, operating feasibility, and partner availability.
* Coordinate discussions with property owners, sellers, operators, hospitality companies, consultants, and potential collaborators.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations with sellers, business owners, hospitality partners, and technology providers.
* Track leadership assignments and ensure that owners, deadlines, dependencies, and outcomes are clearly documented.
* Build and maintain relationships with wellness experts in India and the United States, including clinicians, therapists, retreat designers, nutrition specialists, fitness professionals, and wellness program advisors.
* Identify technology companies that can support wellness operations, guest experience, bookings, CRM, diagnostics, preventive health, digital engagement, or operational reporting.
* Coordinate partnership discussions and help prepare proposals, commercial summaries, meeting notes, and draft agreements.
* Escalate delays, decision gaps, and project risks early, with practical options for resolution.

**Key Deliverables**

**Weekly leadership status report**

Concise update covering project status, key achievements, upcoming milestones, decisions required, risks, and action owners

**Project plans**

Detailed plans for each initiative, including scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, responsibilities, and risk mitigation actions

**Opportunity assessment reports**

Location and business evaluation reports for prospective resorts, retreats, properties, or partnerships

**Stakeholder communication log**

Record of meetings, discussions, commitments, follow\-up actions, and relationship status with partners and experts

**Partnership proposals**

Structured proposals for hospitality, wellness, and technology partners, including commercial rationale and next steps

**Expert network database**

Curated list of wellness experts, their areas of expertise, contact details, past interactions, and potential contribution to current projects

**Leadership action tracker**

Central tracker for Chairman and senior\-management assignments, with ownership, deadlines, progress, and closure status

**Required Experience and Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, business development, strategy, hospitality, wellness, real estate, consulting, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior executives and manage confidential or high\-priority assignments.
* Experience coordinating external stakeholders, including business owners, consultants, vendors, operators, and strategic partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear executive updates and meeting summaries.
* Good commercial judgment and confidence in supporting negotiations and partnership discussions.
* Ability to assess business opportunities using structured criteria rather than relying only on informal discussions.
* Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, and discipline in managing action items.
* Ability to manage several active initiatives at the same time while maintaining clear priorities.
* Proficiency with project\-management and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, Notion, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with the Indian wellness, hospitality, tourism, healthcare, preventive health, or retreat market will be an advantage.
* International exposure or experience working with stakeholders in the United States, Middle East, Europe, or Southeast Asia would be useful.

**Preferred Profile**

The ideal candidate will be practical, organized, and commercially minded. They should be able to move comfortably between a executive\-level briefing, a discussion with a resort operator, a call with a wellness expert, and follow\-up with a technology vendor.

They must know how to turn discussions into clear next steps. For example, after an initial conversation with a resort owner, the Project Manager should document the opportunity, identify missing information, arrange due diligence inputs, track commercial assumptions, and prepare a short decision note for leadership.

This role will suit someone who enjoys building order around complex, evolving initiatives and is willing to take ownership of follow\-up rather than waiting for detailed instructions.
